observation.visible_scene: A woman with glasses and long dark hair, wearing a green-and-white polo shirt (logo 'explora'), sits at a table against a red brick wall crossed by a green horizontal pipe. On the table are a tall water-filled glass near the center, two small white cards, and a black-and-white optical-illusion print at the left. She holds a black marker in her right hand.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-2) the marker is held with its tip just above the rim of the glass, and an inverted/refracted image of her fingers is visible through the water.
She then lifts the marker away from the glass, raising it to her right side and holding it at an angle while looking down at the glass and table (frames ~3-12).

Around frames 13-15 she lowers the marker toward the white paper on the table, and from frame 16 onward she presses the tip to the paper and draws/writes on it, head tilted down, continuing this writing motion through the last frame.
Her torso leans forward and slightly to her right during the writing; the glass, cards, illusion print, and brick background stay at fixed positions in the frame.
Her mouth is open/smiling in the early frames and she looks down at the paper in the later frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: What was drawn on the paper before the clip and what the completed drawing is after it.
The intended demonstration (whether the glass is meant to show refraction of the marker or of her hand).
Whether she is speaking, and the content of any explanation.
uncertain_details: The identity of the inverted image seen inside the glass (refracted fingers vs. refracted marker) cannot be confirmed from the frames.

Slight apparent shifts of the woman across the frame are consistent with her leaning to write rather than with camera movement; the background reference points (pipe joints, window edge) do not clearly move.
Exact contact point of the marker tip on the paper is partly occluded by her hand.
